# Bigme HiBreak Pro (`b651`)

| | |
|---|---|
| Vendor | Bigme |
| SoC | `mt6877` |
| Configuration | `make b651_defconfig` |
| Maintainer | Arthur (fork) |
| Repository | [`devices/b651/`](https://github.com/oosexgang/hakios-xnu-kernel/tree/main/devices/b651) |

## What works

| Part | State | |
|---|---|---|
| display | no | the panel is e-ink (Bigme's EPD controller and waveforms); no such driver exists in the kernel |
| touch | no | the panel's touch layer; there is no driver for this phone's controller yet |
| buttons | no | the keys read through MediaTek's PMIC (PMIF), not the Qualcomm SPMI arbiter hakios.buttons.c walks |
| cpu | no | CONFIG_CPUS=8 and bootcpu=7 are set, but nothing has run on the phone |
| gpu | no | Mali-G68 MC4; the kernel's GPU work is Adreno-only (hakios.adreno.c), and Metal has no Mali path |
| storage | no | UFS 2.2 on MediaTek's UFS host controller; hakios.ufshc.c is the Qualcomm one |
| audio | no | MediaTek audio DSP; hakios.adsp.c is the Qualcomm ADSP loader |
| battery | no | the gauge sits behind MediaTek's PMIC and charger blocks |
| haptic | no | no driver for this phone's motor |
| camera | no | MediaTek ISP (not the Qualcomm one hakios.camera.c speaks to) |
| torch | no | the flash LED is on a MediaTek PMIC |
| wifi | no | MediaTek/Connectivity combo radio; the kernel's Wi-Fi path is the Qualcomm WCN6750 |
| bluetooth | no | same radio |
| cellular | no | the modem is MediaTek's, not the Qualcomm MDM the IPA/QMI path is written for |
| thermal | no | MediaTek LVTS thermal controller |
| usb | no | MediaTek USB device controller; the RAM-only boot path needs it for xl ramdisk |

The state is what has been seen on this device, written down in `devices/b651/device.conf`; a part the table does not name has not been looked at.
